technical_and_design_decisions: All new and modified components will be built on Spring Boot 3.x, which is compatible with the Spring Framework 6.0 Java 17+ requirement, to align with property source and actuator requirements from U4 and U5.

The job module lifecycle change (U2) will use Spring Boot's built-in ApplicationContext lifecycle events and lazy initialization support instead of custom Spring XD runtime lifecycle hooks, reducing custom code and aligning with Boot conventions.

RabbitMQ performance troubleshooting (U7) will leverage existing Micrometer and Spring AMQP actuator metrics rather than building custom instrumentation, to align with the actuator metrics integration from U4 and avoid duplicate work.
CI migration to EC2 (U8) will integrate with the existing GitHub Actions CI workflow, using AWS CodeBuild running on EC2 instances to minimize changes to existing build scripts and processes.

Central external property management (U6) will use Spring Cloud Config Server as the central property store, which natively integrates with Spring Boot's property source management used for U5, ensuring consistency across property handling.

Spark streaming documentation updates (U3) will use the existing Asciidoctor documentation template and build process used for other Spring XD docs, to maintain consistent formatting and publishing workflow.
assumptions: The development team has full access to all required Spring XD core source repositories, AWS account resources for EC2 CI instances, and a dedicated RabbitMQ test cluster for performance testing, with no access delays.
Existing Spring XD automated test suites are compatible with the proposed changes and do not require full rewrites, only minor updates to account for modified component behaviors.

The performance benchmark infrastructure required for U1 can use existing shared cloud test environments already provisioned for the Spring project team, with no need for new hardware procurement or environment setup.
All development team members have existing proficiency with Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Cloud, AWS EC2, and RabbitMQ, so no additional training time is included in estimates.
No changes to the public API of existing Spring XD modules are required for the implemented features, so no additional backward compatibility testing beyond the existing test suite is needed.

activities.activity_name: Document Spring XD cluster infrastructure specifications
activities.activity_description: Gather, validate, and publish detailed infrastructure specifications (hardware, software, network, JDK/application server versions) for reference Spring XD clusters to support user cluster setup, as required by U1.

activities.activity_name: Implement job module lazy context lifecycle
activities.activity_description: Modify the Spring XD job module launcher to only bootstrap the Spring application context when a job is explicitly launched, add shutdown logic to clean up the context after job completion, and update unit tests to cover the new lifecycle behavior, as required by U2.

activities.activity_name: Update Spark streaming documentation and examples
activities.activity_description: Add documentation for tap functionality at Spark module outputs, update existing Spark streaming code examples to reflect current supported features, and add a dedicated section explaining Reliable receiver configuration and use cases, as required by U3.

activities.activity_name: Integrate Boot actuator metrics for XD modules and applications
activities.activity_description: Expose existing Spring XD module and application metrics via Spring Boot actuator endpoints, add custom metrics for module lifecycle events, and update documentation to guide users on accessing metrics via the actuator API, as required by U4.

activities.activity_name: Refactor module option handling to use Boot property sources
activities.activity_description: Remove custom module option parsing logic from the Spring XD core runtime, replace it with Spring Boot @ConfigurationProperties binding for module options, update module metadata to align with Boot's configuration metadata format, and update all related unit and integration tests, as required by U5.

activities.activity_name: Implement central external property management for XD servers
activities.activity_description: Integrate Spring Cloud Config Server as the central external property store, add support for environment-specific property files for XD-Admin and XD-Container servers, update server startup logic to load properties from the central store, and add tests for cross-environment property resolution, as required by U6.

activities.activity_name: Troubleshoot and resolve RabbitMQ message bus performance issues
activities.activity_description: Set up load testing for the RabbitMQ message bus implementation, profile message throughput and latency to identify bottlenecks, implement fixes for identified issues (e.g., connection pooling, prefetch configuration), and add performance regression tests, as required by U7.

activities.activity_name: Migrate MASTER branch CI builds to EC2 instances
activities.activity_description: Configure AWS EC2 instances with required build tools (Java 17, Maven, Docker), update the existing CI pipeline configuration to run builds on EC2 via AWS CodeBuild, test the end-to-end CI pipeline to ensure all builds pass, and decommission legacy CI build nodes, as required by U8.

activities.activity_name: Perform integration and regression testing of the increment
activities.activity_description: Run the full Spring XD automated test suite against all implemented changes, resolve any integration issues between new features, and verify all user stories are fully met with no regressions in existing functionality.
